recent_excerpts: CISA's KEV catalog now lists CVE-2026-20079, a CVSS 10.0 authentication bypass in Cisco software, alongside exploited Citrix and Fortinet flaws. Federal patch deadline: Sept. 12.
Rapid7 IR confirms active exploitation of CVE-2025-59718 — a 9.8-CVSS FortiGate SSO bypass — enabling attackers to gain persistent admin access on unpatched appliances.
A proof-of-concept exploit for CVE-2026-39808, a critical command injection vulnerability in Fortinet FortiSandbox, has been released.
